title.narrative: Institutionalizing Peace in Yemen (IPY)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to lay the foundation for an inclusive and multi-level infrastructure for peace in Yemen. Progress toward this is envisioned to be made via two complementary components: the drafting of a national policy on peace-building and conflict management (national stream), and the management of a Mediation Support Fund (sub-national stream).
